action: Spend 90 minutes actually reading the EV certification page that has been open in the browser. Not skimming. Reading. Map his existing ASE certifications against the prerequisites for EVT (Electric Vehicle Technician) Level 2 certification. Write down on paper what he already has and what the actual gap is — not what he fears the gap is. Identify cost, time commitment, and whether the program can be done while employed.
